page.running_head: De Agro Frif. inter Lavit. & Amaf,

main_text.p: indies diffensione & odio inter partes, agrariis nova collegia, nova tribunalia instituentibus, re ad tumultus atque ar-ma spectante, tandem Rennebergius ve-lut Reip. studio ad avertenda pericula & constituendam provinciam, conventum Ordinum ejus indixit in urbe ipsis Calend. Novemb. anno proximo M. D. LXXVII. Illic cùm statim in initio alter-cationes essent ortæ, contumaciusque & ferociùs agere ac loqui agrarii vide-rentur, quàm ferendum oppidani putabant, quotquot illorum aderant (nec enim venerant omnes) ab his in custo-diam sunt dati. Hinc major secuta ani-morum exacerbatio: cui medendæ, ac sarciendæ concordiæ (periculosus enim ignis ille videbatur, qui toti Belgio in isto rerum statu posset malo esse) ab Auraico Principe & generalibus Ordi-nibus Groningam missus fuit summi in-genii, summæque doctrinæ & autorita-tis vir Philippus Marnixius Aldegondius, & cum eo Sillius jureconsultus Ordini-bus à secretis. Eorumque studio tentata pactitataque multa, conditiones scriptæ

page.notes: The Roman numeral "LXXVII" is printed with spaced letters ("ixxv i i" in the scan); read as LXXVII. The catchword "indu-" is printed at the lower right below the last full line. Long s rendered as s throughout. The faint text at the bottom right edge is a digitiser's watermark and was omitted.
